title: World Bloom — Link the Beats! — Episode7 Reach the Whole World!

meta.Event Outline: VIRTUAL SINGERS in each SEKAI are caring for their respective trees when they are vanished away by a mysterious light. Witnessing this, their counterparts in the space between worlds enter SEKAI to search for them.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright, here's our next song!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We just came here to take a quick break, but now we get to see a show! How lucky are we?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, they all look so cute!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But what's gotten into them all of a sudden? They usually tell us in advance whenever they decide to put on a show.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
True...
I guess they just wanted to surprise us for a change.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thanks for coming to see our show, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Now...
It's time for our really cute guest to take the stage♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Guest...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, is she talking about Miku?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's true, we haven't seen Miku at all yet.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But wouldn't it be odd to call Miku a “guest”?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Alright, let's call her over together!
Ready?

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Luka!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh? Luka?
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hey hey! Are you all having fun?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: There's another Luka...?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Rin and the others have put on a really fun show, but we're just getting started!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Let's keep having fun until the very end!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: H-Her voice is so powerful...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
Not only that, the way she's singing reminds me of...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Thanks, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Singing in a new place always feels so good!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: B-But why are there two of you?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, but our Luka is so cute, and this new Luka is so cool! My heart's been racing this whole time!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, um... Is this girl a fan of ours or something?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Minori loves idols very much♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Seriously, what's going on here?
Why are there two Lukas?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hmm... So, somehow or other, I was sent over here from a different SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: F-From a different SEKAI...?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah, now that you mention it...
She seems really different from everyone here.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(She isn't really an idol.
If anything, she reminds me of An.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Alright, now that I've had a chance to meet all of you, I think I'll start exploring this SEKAI♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I need to be able to tell the others all about this place later!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, in that case, we'll guide you!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We'd also like to take this opportunity to get to know you better, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, thank you!
Then, let's go, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Why don't we start by going to that stage over there? Please follow us.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, Shizuku, that's how you get to the dressing room! The stage is this way!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's incredible how quickly she was able to make friends with everyone.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It looks like I don't need to worry about her now, so I think I'll have a look around this SEKAI myself.
bgm_area00002

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Wooooow!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
This stage is so big!
And the lights are so bright! I can't help but get excited!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
How fun would it be to do an event here?!
The others would love it so much.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The others...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You mean the ones who made your SEKAI, Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes! They're not idols, but they sing and perform on stage too!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: A little while ago, they achieved a dream they've been working toward for a long time. And now, through their singing, they're aiming to stand on top of the world!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-The world?! That's amazing...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But what she just said sounds awfully familiar...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (It couldn't be, surely.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That stage over there has even more gadgets and contraptions! There's even a pad that launches you onto the stage from below.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Wait, that sounds like fun!
I'd love to give it a try!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
This is such a fun SEKAI. Wherever you go, you can find a stage.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Not to mention the flower field stage!
It's so pretty here, singing feels especially good!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Was this also born out of your feelings?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yes, according to Miku and the others.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Our feelings...
Our desire to give everyone hope for a better tomorrow gave rise to all these stages.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Really?
That's so wonderful!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks, Luka!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, also...
The flowers blooming here are called flowers of hope!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Flowers of hope?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's right! They bloom each time we're able to spread hope to someone.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
A lot are still just buds...
But our goal is to get this whole field to bloom someday!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Then, let's try to reach them by singing from here!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: To spread hope to people all around the world, and make this entire field bloom!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: All around the world...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. You think on such a big scale, Luka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But it might be good for us to aim high like she says.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! I really wanna spread hope to lots and lots of people!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Alright, that settles that!
Let's sing!

rows.Speaker: Minori, Haruka, Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Yes!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, here we go!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (To people all around the world.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(How do we reach them?
I guess we just have to really move our bodies and sing even louder!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(This still isn't enough.
What are we missing?)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Her voice is astounding...!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(We can't really match that...!
But...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(Yeah...
If we're gonna reach everyone around the world...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (We'll need to sing as loudly as her!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Did we reach anyone...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I don't know, but I hope so.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Me too...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Is something the matter, Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, look over there...!
se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh? Wait, what's wrong?
se_run_women_001_4

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Look over there!
I think that flower's about to bloom!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, that one too!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Fan's Voice
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I lost again. Maybe I should just quit...

rows.Speaker: Fan's Voice
rows.Line:
...?
That's weird. I thought I heard an MMJ song playing just now...

rows.Speaker: Fan's Voice
rows.Line: Maybe I should keep at it for little longer. Alright, I'll come up with a practice regimen for my next match...!

rows.Speaker: Fan's Voice
rows.Line:
————...♪
Huh? Why was I humming an MMJ song?

rows.Speaker: Fan's Voice
rows.Line:
But I do feel a little better now...
I'll keep studying for those exams.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That was...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Your singing reached them!
Congratulations!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thanks...
We couldn't have done this without you, Luka!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
You gave us the push we needed.
Now we understand that we need to be louder to reach everyone around the world.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! We need to keep doing our best to spread hope to more and more and more people!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I'm sure you girls will succeed.
And I'll be rooting for you!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I need to thank you all as well.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm glad my song was able to reach others like that.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It really is amazing how idols are able to spread hope to others like this!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I wasn't expecting this me to spread hope with Minori and her friends like this.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
The idol version of me was right.
This me really can do anything if she puts her mind to it.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: She was able to give Minori and them the push they needed to keep moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: This really ended up being a wonderful encounter for both parties involved.
